finding_text: Pervasive use of glass curtain walls and artificial illumination deprives users of light-shadow interplay experiences
quote: The pervasive use of glass curtain wall and artificial illumination has saturated contemporary architecture with light, depriving users of the potential experiences achieved through the articulation and interplay of light and shadow

finding_text: Quantifiable metrics for lighting design evaluation deny qualitative spatial perception benefits
quote: The evaluation of light through quantifiable metric design evaluation denies users of qualitative lighting design expression that influences spatial perception and user experience

finding_text: Lighting variability and contrast provide sensorial and perceptual stimulation
quote: Homogeneous and standard lighting solutions deny users sensorial and perceptual stimulation developed through lighting variability and contrast

finding_text: Light-shadow articulation enriches office working environments by establishing relationships between light, built environment, and users
quote: This thesis reconciles the use of light and shadow as an architectural design medium to support and enrich the mundane office working environment, establishing a relationship between light, the built environment, and its users
